John Dory that didn't reach 1kg and they charged us 1.5kg, anyway between the prices being excessive and the weight not being accurate, the surprise comes at the end, I forgot, bread portion and appetizer (olives and pickles) €9.

## Sobre Nosaltres

![Plat gastronòmic del restaurant DiVicnus](https://horizons-cdn.hostinger.com/7e77cf0b-fcd7-48f3-896c-35339d8539c9/fotos-divicnus-web-2025_cpalaciob-170622-063-f-m_divicnus-pJLeR.jpg)

A DiVicnus treballem amb producte de proximitat i de temporada. La nostra cuina és honesta i creativa, amb plats que combinen tradició i innovació.

Sempre amb l'objectiu d'oferir una experiència gastronòmica de qualitat en un ambient càlid i elegant.

Gaudeix dels plats de DiVicnus sense sortir de casa. Nosaltres cuinem i te’ls portem llestos per gaudir.

## About Restaurant Divicnus

Located at Carrer de Sant Miquel dels Sants, 1, 08500 Vic, Barcelona, Spain, **Restaurant Divicnus** offers a cozy and warm atmosphere perfect for dining with friends, family, or even for a romantic evening out. Known for its exceptional service and high-quality food, this local gem has quickly become a favorite among both residents and visitors to Vic.

With a focus on providing a memorable culinary experience, Restaurant Divicnus stands out due to its commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. The restaurant blends traditional Catalan flavors with innovative twists, making each dish an exploration of taste. From mouthwatering meats to fresh seafood, there is something on the menu for everyone.

Among the standout dishes, the grilled Iberian pork is a must-try. Perfectly seasoned and served with a side of crispy roasted vegetables, it embodies the restaurant’s dedication to high-quality, local produce. Another favorite is the seafood paella, which brings together the freshest catches of the day, creating a vibrant and aromatic dish that showcases the best of the Mediterranean. The restaurant also offers a variety of tapas, perfect for sharing and savoring the diverse flavors of Spain in one sitting.

In addition to its impressive food, Restaurant Divicnus takes pride in its inviting space. The restaurant is designed with comfort and style in mind, with warm, rustic interiors that create a homely yet chic atmosphere. Whether you're sitting at the bar or enjoying a table by the window, the ambiance enhances the overall dining experience. The attentive staff ensures that every guest feels welcomed and well-cared for, contributing to the restaurant’s reputation for excellent customer service.

Customers have expressed their satisfaction with their experiences at Restaurant Divicnus, highlighting the flavorful dishes and the friendly, knowledgeable staff. Many patrons have praised the restaurant for its consistency in both food quality and service. Whether it's a casual meal or a special celebration, diners can trust that Restaurant Divicnus will provide an unforgettable experience.

**The restaurant Divicnus** is located in the centre of Vic, Barcelona. In this restaurant they prepare all the food on its carte with fresh quality products and it is characterized by a **creative Mediterranean cuisine**.

Among their dishes the distinguished ones are **the seafood, the grilled octopus or the black risotto**. Moreover, apart from the menu, it also offers several interesting menus: a menu of the day, a Saturday's menu, a tasting menu, a snack menu, a group menu and a children's menu. They also have food for gluten-intolerant people.

Divicnus **allows to give original gifts with its Gastroregals service**. This service consists of a voucher for two people, allowing its receivers to choose from any of Divicnu’s menus, or from any of its à la carte dishes (all the vouchers have house wine, bread, water and coffee included).

Moreover, this restaurant has been decorated with a very good taste and the establishment is warm and welcoming. It also has a terrace to enjoy when there's a good weather, a wine cellar and food packs from 67 € to 90 € to enjoy in couple.

It opens from Tuesday to Saturday from 13:00 to 15:30 and from 20:30 to 22:30. Previous reservations are available.

# Menu and tasting menus in Vic

A changing menu shaped by seasonal ingredients and what arrives in our kitchen each day. À la carte dishes, our Pica-Pica selection and sharing menus, prepared with care and respect for the ingredients.

[Book a table](https://reservviarestaurant.cat/es/?lang=en) [View the menu](https://viarestaurant.cat/es/menu-via-restaurant-vic/#menu-1)

## Nico’s tasting menu

Whole table only

Forget the à la carte menu and enjoy VIA. Every day, Nico creates a unique menu with the finest seasonal ingredients, freshly arrived in our kitchen.

Price €100 · VAT included

Drinks not included.

## VIA’s Pica-Pica

Whole table only

- Bouchot mussels
- Galician razor clam
- Galician cockle
- Grilled Daniel Sorlut spéciale No. 2 oyster
- Andalusian-style anchovies
- Grilled striped prawn
- Grilled langoustine
- Grilled squid
- Fish of the day
- Sourdough bread

Price €65 · VAT included

Drinks not included.

## Fontcuberta Menu

Whole table only

To share

- Homemade croquettes, two varieties
- Stuffed courgette flower
- Garlic king prawn
- Andalusian-style squid

Choice of main course

- XL slow-cooked beef cannelloni
- Charcoal-grilled duck breast
- Confit cod with samfaina
- Monkfish tail from the coast — €10 supplement
- Wagyu fillet from Tavertet — €15 supplement

Dessert and sourdough bread.

Price €55 · VAT included

Drinks not included.

## À la carte

### Fresh fish and seafood

- Daniel Sorlut spéciale No. 2 oyster
- Bouchot mussels
- XL Galician cockles
- XL fine clams from Carril, Galicia
- Sea cucumbers from Llançà
- Andalusian-style baby squid from the coast
- Baby cuttlefish from the coast
- Confit Icelandic cod loin with samfaina
- John Dory from the coast
- Scorpionfish from the coast
- Turbot from the coast
- Whole monkfish from the coast
- XL langoustines
- Red prawn from Palamós
- Carabinero prawn from Huelva

### Croquettes

- Slow-cooked beef croquette
- Cod croquette
- Cep mushroom croquette
- Wagyu croquette from Tavertet
- Carabinero prawn croquette from Huelva
- Red prawn croquette

### Suggestions

- Vic cured sausage by Casa Riera Ordeix 1852
- 100% Iberian ham, D.O. Guijuelo
- Cantabrian anchovies
- Foie micuit with a touch of Pedro Ximénez and caramelised apple
- Icelandic cod carpaccio with tomato tartare and olive tapenade
- A5 wagyu ribeye carpaccio with Parmesan, local pine nuts and Pedro Ximénez reduction
- Red prawn tartare with prawn cream and Calvisius caviar
- Scallop with sea urchin and Calvisius caviar on scallop cream
- Open omelette with ceps and confit pancetta
- XL fish and seafood cannelloni

### Meats

- Slow-cooked Segovia suckling pig
- House-confit Collverd duck leg with ratafia reduction and nuts
- Kid goat shoulder
- Slow-cooked lamb shoulder
- Slow-cooked Angus beef
- Wagyu from Tavertet
- Grilled wagyu fillet from Tavertet
- Certified Japanese A5 wagyu
- Grilled A5 wagyu fillet

### Rice dishes

Served only in paella pans for two guests. Price per person.

- Rice with sea cucumbers from Llançà
- Rice with Palamós red prawn
- Rice with XL langoustine
- Rice with Huelva carabinero prawn
- Seasonal rice
- Black rice with squid and striped prawn

### Desserts

All desserts are made at VIA by our chef. Most are prepared to order.

- Warm cheesecake made to order — 25 minutes
- Valrhona Guanaja 70% chocolate coulant made to order — 25 minutes
- Apple tarte Tatin made to order
- Madagascar vanilla flan
- “La Llimona”
- Please ask for today’s desserts

Menu items may vary according to the season and product availability. If you have any allergy or intolerance, please inform our team before ordering: we will provide details of the allergens present in our dishes.
